title: Double-auction market
description: 60 agents (40 buyers, 20 sellers). The GM clears a discrete double auction each tick.

classes.name: Buyer
classes.proseIdentity: A buyer with a private valuation for a single unit. Wants to buy below valuation; behaves rationally with mild noise.

classes.name: Seller
classes.proseIdentity: A seller with a private cost for a single unit. Wants to sell above cost; mildly noisy.

readmeMd:
# Double-auction market

Discrete clearing every five ticks. The GM does pricing arbitration in this MVP.
